name: Woah: Hand Siege VR
summary:
Woah: Hand Siege VR is a hand-tracking real-time lane strategy game built for quick, satisfying castle battles. Touch a lane with your hand to select your spawn path, then tap a character to summon a unit. Your troops march forward automatically, clash with enemy waves, and push toward the castle. Timing matters—choose the right lane, build momentum, and use powerful skills to break through the frontline and destroy the enemy castle.

Features:
- Hand Tracking controls: touch lanes to select, tap to summon
